title: Use template string to write remainder prompts
goal: Insert the name of the study room and the number of seats that change at any time in a prompt.
summary: template string is wrapped in backticks. Variables or expressions written within ${} are evaluated first and then placed in the literal.
tasks: Complete seatMessage(roomName, seatsLeft) using a template literal.
Return the room name followed by “ has N seats left.”, where N is the supplied seat count. For example, return “South Building Study Room has 8 seats left.”
hint: checks whether backticks are used at both ends of the string. This is the place to check when you see ${roomName} appearing unchanged in the results.

example.note: route card is generated using the same template as "Library Line has 5 stations in total", just pass the route name and station number to the template.
